mapper.select:
SELECT m.CODE, m.ID, m.NAME, m.ADDRESS, m.STATUS, m.RATING, m.CREATED_AT, m.DELETE_YN FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m
ORDER BY m.CREATED_AT DESC, m.CODE DESC LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT m.CODE, m.ID, m.NAME, m.PHONE, m.ADDRESS, m.RATING, m.POINT, m.STATUS, m.CREATED_AT, m.UPDATED_AT, m.LOGGED_AT, m.DELETE_YN, ( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = m.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS path FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m WHERE m.CODE = #{memberCode}

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ce.CHAL_CODE) FROM CHALLENGE_ENTRY ce
INNER JOIN CHALLENGE c ON c.CODE = ce.CHAL_CODE
WHERE ce.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND ce.STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ce.CANCELED_AT IS NULL AND c.DELETE_YN = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM REPORT r WHERE ( r.TARGET_TYPE = 'feed' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM FEED f WHERE f.CODE = r.TARGET_CODE AND f.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} ) ) OR ( r.TARGET_TYPE = 'comment' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.CODE = r.TARGET_CODE AND c.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} ) ) OR ( r.TARGET_TYPE = 'market' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MARKET_PRODUCT p WHERE p.CODE = r.TARGET_CODE AND p.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM FEED WHERE MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND DELETE_YN = 0
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MARKET_DEAL_LOG d WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_ACCOUNT m WHERE m.CODE = #{memberCode} AND ( d.SELLER_ID = m.ID OR d.BUYER_ID = m.ID ) )
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER_ACTIVITY_LOG WHERE MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND ACTION_TYPE = 'LOGIN_SUCCESS'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG ( ADM_CODE, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_CODE, PROCESS_TYPE, MEMO, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{adminCode}, 'member', #{memberCode}, #{processType}, #{reason}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT l.CODE, a.EMP_ID AS ADMIN_ID, l.TARGET_TYPE, l.TARGET_CODE, l.PROCESS_TYPE, l.MEMO, l.CREATED_AT FROM ADMIN_ACTIVITY_LOG l LEFT JOIN ADMIN_ACCOUNT a ON a.CODE = l.ADM_CODE
ORDER BY l.CREATED_AT DESC, l.CODE DESC LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_feed_count, COALESCE(SUM(likes.like_count), 0) AS total_like_count, COALESCE(SUM(f.HITCOUNT), 0) AS total_hit_count FROM FEED f
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT FEED_CODE, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM FEED_LIKE WHERE DELETE_YN = 0 GROUP BY FEED_CODE ) likes ON likes.FEED_CODE = f.CODE

SELECT f.CODE AS code, f.TITLE AS title, f.HITCOUNT AS hitcount, f.CREATED_AT AS created_at, f.UPDATED_AT AS updated_at, ch.TITLE AS challenge_name,
m.CODE AS member_code, m.ID AS member_id, m.RATING AS member_rating,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = m.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profile_image,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = f.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'feed' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnail,
COALESCE(likes.like_count, 0) AS count_feed_like, COALESCE(comments.comment_count, 0) AS count_feed_comment,
fh.TAG_NAME AS tag_name
FROM (
SELECT f.* FROM FEED f
ORDER BY f.CREATED_AT DESC, f.CODE DESC
LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset} ) f
JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = f.MEM_CODE
LEFT JOIN CHALLENGE ch ON ch.CODE = f.CHAL_CODE
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fl.FEED_CODE, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM FEED_LIKE fl WHERE fl.DELETE_YN = 0 GROUP BY fl.FEED_CODE ) likes ON likes.FEED_CODE = f.CODE
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.FEED_CODE, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.DELETE_YN = 0 AND UPPER(c.STATUS) = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.FEED_CODE ) comments ON comments.FEED_CODE = f.CODE
LEFT JOIN FEED_HASHTAG fh ON fh.FEED_CODE = f.CODE
ORDER BY f.CREATED_AT DESC, f.CODE DESC, fh.TAG_NAME ASC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_report_count,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN r.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'IN_REVIEW') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS pending_report_count,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN r.STATUS = 'RESOLVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS resolved_report_count
FROM REPORT r
mapper.sql: WHERE ( d.BUYER_ID = m.ID OR d.SELLER_ID = m.ID )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_trade_count,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN d.BUYER_ID = m.ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS purchase_count,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN d.SELLER_ID = m.ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS sale_count
FROM MARKET_DEAL_LOG d
JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = #{memberCode}
mapper.sql: WHERE f.MEM_CODE = #{memberCode} AND f.DELETE_YN = 0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM CHALLENGE ch WHERE ch.CODE = f.CHAL_CODE )
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_proof_count,
COUNT(DISTINCT f.CHAL_CODE) AS proof_challenge_count,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN f.CREATED_AT BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS recent_proof_count
FROM FEED f

SELECT f.CODE AS code, f.TITLE AS title, f.HITCOUNT AS hitcount, f.CREATED_AT AS created_at, f.UPDATED_AT AS updated_at, ch.TITLE AS challenge_name,
m.CODE AS member_code, m.ID AS member_id, m.RATING AS member_rating,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = m.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'profile' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS profile_image,
( SELECT i.PATH FROM IMAGES i WHERE i.TARGET_CODE = f.CODE AND i.TYPE = 'feed' AND i.DELETE_YN = 0 ORDER BY i.ORDER_SEQ ASC, i.PATH ASC LIMIT 1 ) AS thumbnail,
COALESCE(likes.like_count, 0) AS count_feed_like, COALESCE(comments.comment_count, 0) AS count_feed_comment,
fh.TAG_NAME AS tag_name
FROM (
SELECT f.* FROM FEED f
ORDER BY f.CREATED_AT DESC, f.CODE DESC LIMIT #{perPage} OFFSET #{offset} ) f
JOIN MEMBER_ACCOUNT m ON m.CODE = f.MEM_CODE
JOIN CHALLENGE ch ON ch.CODE = f.CHAL_CODE
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fl.FEED_CODE, COUNT(*) AS like_count FROM FEED_LIKE fl WHERE fl.DELETE_YN = 0 GROUP BY fl.FEED_CODE ) likes ON likes.FEED_CODE = f.CODE
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c.FEED_CODE, COUNT(*) AS comment_count FROM COMMENTS c WHERE c.DELETE_YN = 0 AND UPPER(c.STATUS) = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY c.FEED_CODE ) comments ON comments.FEED_CODE = f.CODE
LEFT JOIN FEED_HASHTAG fh ON fh.FEED_CODE = f.CODE
ORDER BY f.CREATED_AT DESC, f.CODE DESC, fh.TAG_NAME ASC
